sense: to make something easier for someone

pins.definition: To assist or support someone, or to make something easier to do.
To make it easier or possible for someone to do something by offering aid.
To give support or assistance to someone so they can do something more easily.

situation: A woman helps an elderly man who has stopped on the pavement: she holds his arm with one hand and carries his heavy shopping bag in the other, while he smiles thankfully and leans on her arm. The street is sunny and quiet and both people are drawn with full hands and faces.
subject: one person helping another carry and walk
